grep -rHn "^Dispatch barrier\." skills/implement/ | while IFS= read -r line; do
  h=$(printf '%s' "${line#*:*:}" | md5sum | cut -c1-8)

d = {'command': 'lib/test/run-shard.sh monolith', 'tree': 'current', 'purpose': 'AC5 lint-reference-size via monolith shard'}
